metadata.title: Bevacizumab 15 mg/kg, Paclitaxel 175 mg/m² and Carboplatin AUC 6 Therapy
metadata.indication: First-line treatment of FIGO stage IIIB, IIIC or IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer.
metadata.source_title_exact: Bevacizumab 15 mg/kg, PACLitaxel 175 mg/m² and CARBOplatin AUC 6 Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Encoded protocol · full source coverage review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The protocol has executable SACTCheck content but has not yet completed the v0.68.0 full source fidelity review. Use the current NCCP source as authoritative.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: First-line treatment of FIGO stage IIIB, IIIC or IV epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer.

administration.note: After surgery initiate bevacizumab from cycle 2, subject to healing and surgical safety criteria.

notes: Overall cap 15 months (22 cycles), including combination treatment.

neuropathy_grade.label: Peripheral neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; minimal, local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant but not immediately life-threatening; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory and/or motor symptoms and their effect on instrumental versus self-care activities of daily living. Distinguish transient cold sensitivity from persistent functional neuropathy.
